summary: Frontend-only verification for Coco AI (Next.js production build): redesigned upgrade gate, dashboard tier card, news signals detail sheet with drag-to-dismiss, and management page. All requested testids exist and behave correctly on both desktop (1920px) and mobile (390px). Premium tier restored at end.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking the upgrade-gate-backdrop element via Playwright at its center does not close the sheet on desktop (1920px). The backdrop is a full-viewport <button> and the .ug-sheet sits above it at the center, so a center click lands on the sheet. User clicks in the visible backdrop area DO close the sheet (Escape and X buttons close correctly, and mobile drag-down works). This is a testing-only observation; not a functional bug for real users. Consider adding stopPropagation on sheet and/or using pointer-events pattern so the [data-testid] centroid is not covered.

critical_code_review_comments: upgrade-gate-backdrop is a full-viewport <button> visually covered at its centroid by .ug-sheet; automated tests that target the backdrop centroid can't dismiss it. Adding an explicit outside-click handler on ug-root (excluding sheet) would be more testable and semantically cleaner than a hidden button.
components/management-view.tsx is 470+ lines and mixes Field/MtgToggle/ProgressPanel/TradeSheet/Row/Celebration — consider splitting for maintainability.
